subject: Sandbox access & POC kickoff — activation plan and owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@tidewaterhealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@tidewaterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox access & POC kickoff — activation plan and owners

Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Great to meet you on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed activation plan so we have a single place to track owners and deadlines.

TL;DR: Redwood will provision a short-lived sandbox environment for Tidewater Health, share an ephemeral API key and SSO invite, and provide an evaluation dashboard. Goal is a 2-week hands-on POC with the success criteria below.

Success criteria (agreed, final to be confirmed by you):
- Integration: Server-to-server embedding and generation calls functioning from Tidewater dev and staging networks.
- Latency: p95 text-gen < 250ms for 512-token requests (target; we can accept up to 300ms if needed).
- Quality: embedding-based search recall > 0.78 on your sample query set (we'll import your test set).
- Security: SSO for product team members + IP allowlist for service account calls.

Evaluation plan and timeline:
- Day 0 (this week): SSO invites sent, ephemeral API key issued, IP allowlist configured on Redwood side.
- Week 1: Integration and smoke tests (Embedding/Generation).
- Week 2: Workload testing, quality checks, and a short review call to validate success criteria.

Owners / points of contact:
- Redwood (PD/ops): Ben Carter — AE / project owner (ben@redwood.com)
- Redwood (CS/ops): Marissa Cole — technical delivery lead (marissa@redwood.com)
- Tidewater: Alyssa Moore — product owner (alyssa@tidewaterhealth.com); Tom Ellis — DevOps lead (tom.ellis@tidewaterhealth.com)

Access asks from Redwood (what we need from Tidewater):
1) SAML IdP metadata or an admin email to invite (we can support SAML2 / Okta / Azure AD).
2) IP ranges to whitelist (please attach CSV or paste CIDRs).
3) Names & emails of the 4 people you want in the sandbox team (we'll send SSO invites).

Attachments: I attached a short playbook (sandbox-activation-playbook.xlsx) that lists the step-by-step items we will run through and a template for the test data you can drop into the environment.

Next actions (for this week):
- Alyssa: reply with IdP metadata + IP ranges + list of 4 users (by EOD tomorrow).
- Marissa: start the provisioning ticket with infra once we have the IPs and IdP.
- Ben: schedule a 30-min check-in for Day 3 and Day 10 of the trial (I'll send a calendar invite).

If any of the success criteria above need to be adjusted, call it out in your reply and we can align before we start provisioning.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you into a working sandbox.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: sandbox-activation-playbook.xlsx

From: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@tidewaterhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@tidewaterhealth.com>, DevOps Team <devops@tidewaterhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access & POC kickoff — activation plan and owners

Ben — thanks for the clear summary and next steps. Quick confirmations from Tidewater:

1) Owners: Alyssa (product), Tom (DevOps), Sara Lim (ML eng, sara.lim@tidewaterhealth.com), Kyle Park (backend, kyle.park@tidewaterhealth.com). Please add these four to the SSO invite.
2) IdP: We use Okta. I attached the Okta SAML metadata export and our current IP ranges for outbound traffic (tidewater-ip-ranges.csv).
3) IPs: Our DevOps team prefers we whitelist the CIDRs in the CSV; if you need single IPs for NAT egress please confirm and we'll provide.

On the API key: security would prefer an ephemeral key limited to the sandbox project with a 14-day TTL and only embedding + generation scopes. Can you do a scoped key with granular scopes and audit logging enabled?

Success criteria: product-team is comfortable with target latency p95 up to 300ms for initial testing (so your 250ms is our ideal but not blocking). We also prefer recall > 0.75 for the initial run.

Attached: tidewater-ip-ranges.csv (IP ranges) and Okta SAML metadata (okta_metadata.xml).

We'll aim to be ready for Day 0 on Friday (3 July) if you can provision before then.

Thanks — Alyssa
Alyssa Moore
Senior PM, Tidewater Health
alyssa@tidewaterhealth.com

Attachments: tidewater-ip-ranges.csv, okta_metadata.xml

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: infra-requests@redwood-infra.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: [Provisioning] TDW-2026-032 — sandbox project, ephemeral key, SSO entry, IP allowlist

Infra team — please action the following for Tidewater Health (TDW-2026-032). Alyssa attached their IP CIDRs and Okta metadata earlier. I pasted the key items below.

Requested work items (priority: high; target completion: EOD Thu 2026-07-02):
- Create dedicated sandbox project: tdw-sandbox-tdw-032 (isolated tenant).
- Add SAML integration using provided Okta metadata; create SSO group "tdw-sandbox-team" and add the four users once invites are sent.
- Whitelist outbound IP CIDRs: (see tidewater-ip-ranges.csv attachment). Configure both NAT and control-plane allowlist.
- Generate an ephemeral service API key with the following constraints:
   * Name: tdw_ephemeral_trial_key_2026_07
   * Scopes: embeddings:read, embeddings:write, generation:invoke
   * TTL: 14 days (auto-expire)
   * Audit logging: enabled (include requestor=ben_carter)
- Add an Ops note in the project that this key is for trial only and cannot be used for production.

Attachments: tidewater-ip-ranges.csv, redwood-ephemeral-key-instructions.txt

If infra needs anything else from me (or a service account to own the resource), reply here and I'll move it along.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Technical Delivery Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@tidewaterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 10:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access & POC kickoff — activation plan and owners

Alyssa — quick update and everything you asked for is now in place.

What we provisioned (completed 2026-07-02 16:12 UTC):
- Sandbox project: tdw-sandbox-tdw-032 (isolated tenant).
- SSO: Okta SAML entry created; 4 invites sent to the emails you provided. Please check spam if anyone doesn't see the invite.
- IP allowlist: CIDRs from tidewater-ip-ranges.csv added to both NAT and control-plane allowlists.
- Ephemeral API key: tdw_ephemeral_trial_key_2026_07 (this is a display name; the actual key below is the token to use).

Ephemeral key (one-time shown here): rw_trial_key_5fT9-XXXX-XXXX-8aB2
Scopes: embeddings:read, embeddings:write, generation:invoke
TTL: 14 days (expires 2026-07-16T16:12:00Z)
Audit: enabled; logs will appear under project tdw-sandbox-tdw-032 -> activity

SSO invite link: https://console.redwood.com/sso/invite/tdw-sandbox-tdw-032
Playbook & dashboard: https://drive.redwood.com/sandbox/TDW-032/playbook and https://app.redwood.ai/teams/tdw/poc-dashboard

Next steps (for this week):
- Tidewater: kick off integration tests using the ephemeral key; let us know if you hit 403s on any call (Marissa -> we should confirm scopes mapping).
- Ben/Marissa: schedule Day 3 check-in (Fri 2026-07-03 10:00am PT) and Day 10 review (Thu 2026-07-09 09:00am PT). Calendar invites to follow.

If you'd prefer a longer TTL or a different scope set, we can update — but this key is intentionally tight for trial security.

Thanks everyone — excited to see how the Tidewater team gets on with the sandbox.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
